description: A four-panel composite (2x2) of dark-field (DF) TEM micrographs, each with a selected-area diffraction pattern (SADP) inset in its upper-right corner, comparing the ferrite of Fe–28Mn–9Al-1.2C-xCr strips (0Cr, 3Cr, 6Cr, 9Cr). Every panel carries a 500 nm scale bar. (a) 0Cr: DF image of a single smooth, largely featureless bright ferrite grain on a dark matrix; the inset SADP, indexed [111]δ, is labelled (1̄01), (1̄1̄0), (0̄11) and (000) with concentric circles marking the reflections used for imaging. (b) 3Cr: DF image of a ferrite grain crossed by broad dark bands; inset SADP indexed [111]δ, labelled (101), (110), (011) and (000). Insets (a) and (b) contain only single-phase δ reflections. (c) 6Cr and (d) 9Cr are mottled DF images densely speckled with nano-scale bright particles, overlaid with yellow text "δ+DO3"; their insets are two-phase patterns, [001]δ+[001]DO3 labelled (100), (110), (200), (000) and [011]δ+[011]DO3 labelled (200), (211), (011), (111), (1̄11), (000), with circled superlattice reflections used for imaging. The figure demonstrates that DO3 superlattice reflections and nano-scale DO3 particles appear only in the 6Cr and 9Cr strips, not in 0Cr or 3Cr.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a dark-field TEM image of the 0Cr strip showing a single large, smooth, essentially featureless bright ferrite grain on a dark background with a 500 nm scale bar.
The inset SADP of panel (a) is indexed along the [111]δ zone axis with spots labelled (1̄01), (1̄1̄0), (0̄11) and (000), and the reflections used for imaging are marked with concentric circles.
The caption states that (a) is a DF image of the 0Cr strip obtained using (110)δ and that the inset is the corresponding SADP.

Panel (b) is a dark-field TEM image of the 3Cr strip ferrite showing broad dark bands crossing the grain, with a 500 nm scale bar, and an inset SADP indexed [111]δ labelled (101), (110), (011), (000).
The caption states that (b) is a DF image of the 3Cr strip obtained using (1̄10)δ with its corresponding SADP.
Panels (c) and (d) both carry yellow overlay text reading 'δ+DO3', which is absent from panels (a) and (b).

Panel (c) is a dark-field image of the 6Cr strip showing a dark matrix densely speckled with nano-scale bright particles; its inset SADP has superimposed zone axes [001]δ+[001]DO3 and is labelled (100), (110), (200), (000).

Panel (d) is a dark-field image of the 9Cr strip showing a mottled matrix with fine bright nano-scale particles and a darker band at the upper left; its inset SADP has superimposed zone axes [011]δ+[011]DO3 labelled (200), (211), (011), (111), (1̄11), (000).
The caption states that (c) is a DF image of the 6Cr strip obtained using 200''>(200)DO3 and (d) is a DF image of the 9Cr strip obtained using (200)DO3, each with a corresponding SADP.
All four panels contain a printed scale bar labelled 500 nm.
The citing text states that in the ferrite of the 0Cr and 3Cr strips no superlattice is observed and the images show almost clean features without evident secondary phases.
The citing text states that in the 6Cr and 9Cr strips a superlattice belonging to the DO3 phase in ferrite is observed, identified because (hkl) are all odd or all even.
The citing text states that according to the DF images of ferrite, nano-scale DO3 phases clearly appear in the ferrite of the 6Cr and 9Cr strips.
The citing text states that only a few dislocations are occasionally observed in the ferrite of all strips.

subfigures.description: DF TEM image of the 0Cr strip ferrite: one large, smooth, nearly featureless bright ferrite grain against a dark background, 500 nm scale bar. Inset SADP indexed along [111]δ with labelled spots (1̄01), (1̄1̄0), (0̄11), (000); concentric circles mark the reflections used for the DF image.

DF TEM image of the 3Cr strip ferrite: a ferrite grain showing broad dark banded contrast against black background, 500 nm scale bar. Inset SADP indexed [111]δ with spots labelled (101), (110), (011) and (000), one reflection ringed.

DF TEM image of the 6Cr strip ferrite taken with a DO3 reflection: dark field densely speckled with fine nano-scale bright particles, yellow overlay text 'δ+DO3', 500 nm scale bar. Inset SADP with two zone axes superimposed, [001]δ+[001]DO3, labelled (100), (110), (200), (000), the (110) and (100)-type spots ringed.

DF TEM image of the 9Cr strip ferrite taken with (200)DO3: mottled grey matrix containing fine bright nano-scale particles, with a darker band running across the top-left, yellow overlay text 'δ+DO3', 500 nm scale bar. Inset SADP with superimposed zone axes [011]δ+[011]DO3, labelled (200), (211), (011), (111), (1̄11), (200), (000), several superlattice spots ringed.

unreadable_items: Individual nano-scale DO3 particle sizes in panels (c) and (d) are below the resolution of the supplied images and cannot be measured or counted
Exact intensities of the SADP reflections in the insets cannot be read from the reproduced halftone patterns
